en.hubeali: H 14752 – From him, from Salih, from Ali Bin Al-Hakam, from Abaan Bin Usman, who has said: Abu Abdullahasws has said:
‘Iblees<sup>la</sup> has a helper called ‘تَمْرِيحٌ’ Tamreeh. When the night comes, he fills what is between the two palpitations (of the heart)’.
en.sarwar: 304. From him, from Salih, from Ali Bin Al-Hakam, from Abaan Bin Usman, who has said: Abu Abdullah (a.s.) has said:
‘Iblees (la) has a helper called ‘تَمْرِيحٌ’ Tamreeh. When the night comes, he fills what is between the two palpitations (of the heart)’.
